Runtime capability matrix Preview

A pack declares the (provider, engine) runtimes it requires. The matrix below is normative reference derived from the runtime capability declarations in @tenkacloud/problem-runtime (EXECUTABLE_PROVIDER / EXECUTABLE_ENGINE, RESERVED_RUNTIMES, and CONTAINER_RUNTIMES). When an engine ships it moves out of the reserved set and this table regenerates automatically.

Matrix

ProviderEngineSupportMaturityNotes
awscloudformationexecutableStableThe only cloud-executable runtime today: deployed via CloudFormation CreateStack.
azurebicepreservedPlannedReserved roadmap runtime: recognized by the validator but no adapter ships yet.
dockercomposecontainerPreviewLocal container runtime (make local). Recognized but never cloud-deployed.
gcpinfra-managerreservedPlannedReserved roadmap runtime: recognized by the validator but no adapter ships yet.
sakuraapprunreservedPlannedReserved roadmap runtime: recognized by the validator but no adapter ships yet.

Support classes

  • executable — cloud-deployable today. The deploy worker runs a CloudFormation CreateStack in the competitor account.
  • reserved — a recognized roadmap provider/engine with no adapter yet. The validator accepts it but the deploy worker rejects a cloud deploy loudly.
  • container — a local container runtime (make local). Recognized but never cloud-deployed.

AWS is Stable; GCP, Azure, and Sakura are Planned reserved roadmap targets.
